commit.message:
FIF A24: page error states leak no locked content (Node test lane) (#9861)

Close Z0 closure-matrix row A24 with a hermetic node:test module over
templates/fundamental_forensics.js at BASE: one programmable-fetch page
context drives the desk's own failure branches (bundle network/503 via
the gate Retry, health rejection, compare-chain network/500, export 500,
attested-history /latest and roots rejections) and pins, per state, that
the page's own error copy renders, the authorized node's text and SEC
source href still resolve, LOCKED-SENTINEL-7f3a (refused-statement
identity, withheld-cell fields, missing-node values plus its
companyfacts_response_sha256 digest, javascript:-scheme receipt url,
5xx bodies) reaches no rendered node and no fetched URL, and every
fetched URL is page-constructed. CI: append the module to the
fif-kernel-guards node --test line.

Co-authored-by: Sol CEO <actions@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>
